vctk_attempt.reason: single-stream archive download (https://datashare.ed.ac.uk/.../VCTK-Corpus-0.92.zip) ran at a very slow and intermittently stalling rate for its full ~11GB size; after a long wait with only partial, non-extractable zip bytes on disk, the partial file was DELETED rather than manifested -- a truncated zip is not usable data the way FSD50K's already-complete individual clip files were, so recording partial bytes here would misrepresent what is actually on disk. No manifest was written for this entry; it remains unfetched (is_present() will retry it cleanly on a future run) rather than falsely marked done.

entries.note: cut off short of its 6GB budget: the concurrent download loop deadlocked mid-run (all worker threads parked in futex_wait_queue, zero network activity, for hours -- a Python-level lock-contention bug, not a network stall). Finalized from what was ACTUALLY on disk and verified complete (6282 whole clip files) rather than retried, to avoid risking the same deadlock again. Diagnosis and the wall-clock-deadline mitigation are in this branch's fix commits.
